criteria.description: A push to `develop` builds the buildable set and publishes every publishable package to npm.pkg.github.com
criteria.evidence: release-rc.yml delegates to publish-packages.yml, which resolves the set via release-graph.mjs --dirs and publishes each. Asserted by check-release-graph.mjs (job `publish`); deleting the publish step, the derivation, or the caller are each refused (probes: 'not publishing at all', 'no workflow delegating to the payload at all').
criteria.notes: Evidence recorded; pass_fail stays pending until the payload executes once for real — nothing in this mission's diff has ever run.

criteria.description: The publishing job declares `packages: write` — without it GITHUB_TOKEN cannot publish at all
criteria.evidence: publish-packages.yml declares `contents: read` + `packages: write`; checkPublishingCallersDelegate asserts every caller GRANTS at least what the payload declares, because the caller's block is a ceiling and a shortfall fails validation before the run starts. Probes: 'a caller granting less than the payload declares', 'a caller with no permissions block at all'.
criteria.notes: Evidence recorded; pass_fail stays pending until the payload executes once for real — nothing in this mission's diff has ever run.

criteria.evidence: main() runs `npm install --package-lock-only` once after all manifests are written, captures the output, and refuses with npm's last 12 lines on failure rather than proceeding. Verified by a review lens end-to-end.

criteria.description: The root .npmrc scope mapping points at npm.pkg.github.com, not registry.npmjs.org

criteria.evidence: The resolve step captures PROJECTS/DIRS into variables and asserts each non-empty before use; the audit and publish loops re-assert. Probe: 'a graph accessor that returns an empty array instead of throwing'.

criteria.description: The rc publish never writes dist-tag `latest`
criteria.evidence: Four independent guards, each added after the unguarded form was MEASURED green: per-invocation `--tag` on every npm publish line (comments stripped), refusal of a hard-coded `--tag latest`, a requirement that TAG derive from inputs.dist-tag, and caller-side refusal of `dist-tag: latest` from a non-tag-triggered workflow. Verified absent on the live packages.

criteria.evidence: admittingRange(); measured on the real tree as 12 range rewrites across 9 manifests, including two consumers declaring a bare `*` — which excludes prereleases exactly as a caret does. Without this the four packages could not resolve each other.

negative_invariants.invariant: The rc stream never writes dist-tag `latest`
negative_invariants.why: The first publish of a package with no existing versions would claim the prod channel, and that cannot be undone.
negative_invariants.guarded_by: check-release-graph.mjs — four guards, each added after the unguarded form was measured green

negative_invariants.invariant: A failed publish halts the loop rather than continuing
negative_invariants.why: The set publishes in topological order; continuing past a failure ships dependents against a peer version that does not exist, permanently.
negative_invariants.guarded_by: publish-packages.yml publish loop (`break`), ported from release.yml

negative_invariants.invariant: The payload never declares a permission above what its caller grants
negative_invariants.why: A called workflow declaring above the caller's ceiling fails workflow validation and the run never starts.

negative_invariants.invariant: No gate reports green over an empty set
negative_invariants.why: Standing repo rule; a green line over zero inputs is a defect.
negative_invariants.guarded_by: non-empty assertions in the resolve/audit/publish steps, plus a positive floor on delegating callers
